rows.grounds: object of satisfaction; accusative form of second-person pronoun
indicates perpetual continuity of the act
first-person declaration of complete ritual satisfaction
qualifies the object as satisfied in entirety
locative compound describing the deity's seat: śveta-abja-madhya-āsana

items.question: In what form and manner is the addressed deity perpetually and completely satisfied?
premises: The speaker performs an act of complete satisfaction.
This act of satisfaction is performed perpetually.
The addressed deity is whole and seated in the center of a white lotus.
items.inference: Therefore, the deity is perpetually and wholly satisfied in the form seated at the center of a white lotus.
uncertainties: The exact referent of 'tvān' depends on the preceding ritual sequence and is not fully specified within this verse alone.
items.plain_english: I always fully satisfy you, whole and complete, as you are seated in the center of a white lotus.
